svg.title: Swimlane: P4 Pipeline operator
svg.desc: 10 numbered steps of Pipeline operator left to right across 2 system lanes; each card shows its trigger, page, action, data written and hand-off, with dashed fallback cards below.

g.aria-label: P4 step 1 on start-dev: git switch main && git pull; bash scripts/start-dev.sh. Trigger: code change on main. Writes: images, schema migrations, ingestion_jobs transition_scoring seed. Fallback: re-run; never reset the Postgres volume.
g.title: P4 step 1 on start-dev: git switch main && git pull; bash scripts/start-dev.sh. Trigger: code change on main. Writes: images, schema migrations, ingestion_jobs transition_scoring seed. Fallback: re-run; never reset the Postgres volume.

g.aria-label: Fallback branch of step 1
g.title: Fallback branch of step 1

g.aria-label: Fallback for step 1: re-run; never reset the Postgres volume
g.title: Fallback for step 1: re-run; never reset the Postgres volume

g.aria-label: P4 step 2 on import-music-library: bash scripts/import-music-library.sh after the musicLibrary weekly run. Trigger: weekly musicLibrary run. Writes: ingestion_jobs library_ingest. Hands off library.json (export shape) via sn-be-sig-import-music-library. Fallback: script retries a dead job once, then prints the error.
g.title: P4 step 2 on import-music-library: bash scripts/import-music-library.sh after the musicLibrary weekly run. Trigger: weekly musicLibrary run. Writes: ingestion_jobs library_ingest. Hands off library.json (export shape) via sn-be-sig-import-music-library. Fallback: script retries a dead job once, then prints the error.

g.aria-label: Fallback branch of step 2
g.title: Fallback branch of step 2

g.aria-label: Fallback for step 2: script retries a dead job once, then prints the error
g.title: Fallback for step 2: script retries a dead job once, then prints the error

g.aria-label: P4 step 3 on Worker: worker runs library_ingest, projection and backfill follow-ups. Trigger: beat drain. Writes: library.*, target_tracks, outbox, projection_tracks. Hands off outbox events via sn-be-sql-outbox. Fallback: projection_reconcile job.
g.title: P4 step 3 on Worker: worker runs library_ingest, projection and backfill follow-ups. Trigger: beat drain. Writes: library.*, target_tracks, outbox, projection_tracks. Hands off outbox events via sn-be-sql-outbox. Fallback: projection_reconcile job.

g.aria-label: Fallback branch of step 3
g.title: Fallback branch of step 3

g.aria-label: Fallback for step 3: projection_reconcile job
g.title: Fallback for step 3: projection_reconcile job

g.aria-label: P4 step 4 on REST API: PUT /api/v1/scrape/window and manage /api/v1/target-tracks. Trigger: planning. Writes: scrape_window, target_tracks. Fallback: no window = scrape every hour.
g.title: P4 step 4 on REST API: PUT /api/v1/scrape/window and manage /api/v1/target-tracks. Trigger: planning. Writes: scrape_window, target_tracks. Fallback: no window = scrape every hour.

g.title: Fallback branch of step 4

g.aria-label: Fallback for step 4: no window = scrape every hour
g.title: Fallback for step 4: no window = scrape every hour

g.aria-label: P4 step 5 on REST API: watch /api/v1/jobs and /api/v1/jobs/{id}/stages; POST /retry for dead jobs. Trigger: dead letter or warning. Writes: ingestion_jobs. Fallback: docker compose logs worker.
g.title: P4 step 5 on REST API: watch /api/v1/jobs and /api/v1/jobs/{id}/stages; POST /retry for dead jobs. Trigger: dead letter or warning. Writes: ingestion_jobs. Fallback: docker compose logs worker.

g.title: Fallback branch of step 5

g.title: Fallback for step 5: docker compose logs worker

g.aria-label: P4 step 6 on songnodes Postgres 18: pg_dump -Fc via compose exec. Trigger: before risky change. Writes: backup-YYYYMMDD.dump. Fallback: none: scripts/backup_database.sh targets the wrong database.
g.title: P4 step 6 on songnodes Postgres 18: pg_dump -Fc via compose exec. Trigger: before risky change. Writes: backup-YYYYMMDD.dump. Fallback: none: scripts/backup_database.sh targets the wrong database.

g.aria-label: P4 step 7 on Telemetry: queue scrape. Trigger: scrape form. Writes: POST /api/v1/scrape/trigger. Fallback: toast with HTTP detail.
g.title: P4 step 7 on Telemetry: queue scrape. Trigger: scrape form. Writes: POST /api/v1/scrape/trigger. Fallback: toast with HTTP detail.

g.aria-label: P4 step 8 on Telemetry: retry job. Trigger: ConfirmDialog. Writes: POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/retry.
g.title: P4 step 8 on Telemetry: retry job. Trigger: ConfirmDialog. Writes: POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/retry.

g.aria-label: P4 step 9 on Settings: connect TIDAL. Trigger: /settings/tidal-connection. Writes: sessionStorage state; backend token store. Fallback: error banner on Settings.
g.title: P4 step 9 on Settings: connect TIDAL. Trigger: /settings/tidal-connection. Writes: sessionStorage state; backend token store. Fallback: error banner on Settings.

g.aria-label: P4 step 10 on Import tracklist: find and import AI setlists. Trigger: /sources/import. Writes: POST /api/v1/tracks/import-tracklist; songnodes_ai_setlists_ledger. Hands off job rows via REST -> RabbitMQ/Celery (backend scope). Fallback: ledger kept locally.
g.title: P4 step 10 on Import tracklist: find and import AI setlists. Trigger: /sources/import. Writes: POST /api/v1/tracks/import-tracklist; songnodes_ai_setlists_ledger. Hands off job rows via REST -> RabbitMQ/Celery (backend scope). Fallback: ledger kept locally.
